name: Mimic
source: The manager of the dungeon's treasure chests. she is the god of chests... or something like that. If you spring a mimic trap. she will appear from inside the chest. Her primary duty is to punish pitiful adventurers who fail to disarm the traps on chests. Lately she's becoming annoyed that the nickname ”Mimiko' is catching on, due to the fact that she looks like a miko shrine maiden.
